variables.name: prior_summary_block
variables.description: Optional prior-summary section. When a previous compaction exists, the caller renders this as 'Prior summary (extend or refine):\n<summary>\n'. Otherwise an empty string so the prompt starts straight at the transcript.
examples:
Prior summary (extend or refine):
User asked Magician to research the Q3 OKR retro. Two tasks were spawned: one to pull the OKR doc, one to summarise the prior retro notes.

variables.name: transcript_block
variables.description: The new turns to fold into the summary, rendered one per line as 'role: text'. The caller assembles this from chat-ledger ChatMessageContent::Text entries since the prior compaction's last_compacted_turn_id. Heading line varies based on whether prior_summary_block was supplied — 'New turns since prior summary:' vs 'Conversation transcript to summarise:'.
examples:
New turns since prior summary:
user: Did the Q3 doc come back yet?
assistant: Still pulling it — should land in about a minute.

metadata.description: User template for the voice context compactor. Two variables — the optional prior summary block and the required transcript block — are pre-assembled by the caller so the prompt manager doesn't need to know the chat-ledger shape.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial release. Two pre-assembled blocks plus a trailing 'produce now' nudge.
